title: Metate
tagline: Metate allows anyone to stream XOC - decentralized Mexican Pesos
description:
The idea is to create cheap and easy ways to start Superfluid streams for XOC on Polygon. This will open up a new paradigm for payments in Mexico where finance has been stuck for a century, Metate allows workers to get paid exactly for what they work for and businesses can run their operations more efficiently. Same for other use-cases as TV or internet subscriptions, they could be paid via Metate.

The most important use-case is remittances, where 12.5 billion dollars were transferred from the US to Mexico last year alone and the average fee % taken from each transaction hovers around 10 to 14% of the transaction's value.
how_its_made:
First, we decided to launch on Polygon as it is the best current alternative to building on Ethereum Mainnet due to the high gas fees. 
We then chose Superfluid as our go-to sponsors as we deemed it the perfect candidate for our Proof-of-Concept with Xocolatl, a decentralized Mexican stablecoin deployed by the PipilaDAO -- a group of Mexican hackers working on onboarding more Mexicans into DeFi.
